A little help for your next round of MegaBlast Mayhem.

Good places to start

The game won’t launch or something isn’t working

Restart the game and Steam, then check that the game is up to date. In your Steam Library, right-click the game, choose Properties → Installed Files → Verify integrity of game files.

Check Windows and graphics-driver updates, and compare your setup with the system requirements. If the issue continues, include the details below in a report.

How does multiplayer work?

MegaBlast Mayhem supports up to four local players on one shared screen. Connect your controllers, choose your players, and let bots fill the other seats. Online multiplayer is not included.

My controller isn’t responding

Connect your controller before launching the game. Check that Windows and Steam recognize it, then review the game’s controller settings in Steam. If the problem continues, include the controller model and connection type in your report.

Do I need the base game for Padmara?

Yes. Padmara is downloadable content for Eucalyptus Edge: MegaBlast Mayhem and requires the base game on Steam. The expansion is coming November 13, 2026.

Explore Padmara
Where do I find news and patch notes?

Official news and game updates are posted in the Steam news feed.

Read the latest updates
I need help with a Steam purchase or refund

Purchases, account access, downloads, and refunds are handled through Steam. Sign in to Steam Support to select your purchase and see the available options.

Open Steam Support

Still need a hand?

Tell us what happened.

Post a report in the game’s Steam discussions so the studio can review it.

Open Steam discussions

Include these details

  • Game version or build number
  • What you expected and what happened
  • Steps to reproduce the issue
  • Your Windows version and hardware
  • Controller model, if relevant
  • Screenshots or diagnostics, if available

Keep account credentials, payment information, and other private details out of public reports.
